# Grimms Automovation

> > Grimms Automovation delivers 24/7 heavy-duty towing, recovery, and truck repair services across Maryland, Pennsylvania, and DC.

Grimms Automovation is a comprehensive automotive service provider specializing in commercial truck towing, semi-truck recovery, and diesel engine repair. Operating around the clock from Frederick, MD, they serve the tri-state region with emergency roadside assistance, fleet maintenance, and specialized heavy-duty repair services.
